conclusions.description: A monthly energy estimate can be calculated from valid power, quantity and usage inputs.
conclusions.caveat: Estimate assumes the entered power is representative during the stated operating hours.

conclusions.description: A variable energy-cost estimate can be calculated from estimated kWh and a user-entered rate.
conclusions.caveat: Excludes fixed charges, taxes, slabs, duties, adjustments and other bill components unless included in the entered rate.

conclusions.description: A standby-energy estimate can be calculated when standby power is known or measured.
conclusions.caveat: Do not assume standby power equals rated operating power; obtain a standby measurement or manufacturer value.

conclusions.description: The user may be able to review operating schedules where usage is flexible.
conclusions.caveat: A review candidate is not proof of waste or guaranteed savings.

conclusions.description: A reported electrical warning symptom warrants stopping use where safe and seeking a qualified electrician.
conclusions.caveat: The system does not diagnose wiring faults or provide repair instructions.

conclusions.description: Compare verified energy labels or manufacturer specifications before judging appliance efficiency.
conclusions.caveat: Do not infer efficiency from appliance age, brand or rated wattage alone.
